tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search public agentready.ch company profiles by name, category, region or service.

tools.name: search_company_directory
tools.description: Structured discovery for agents. Search by company name, service, category, region and available function. Returns slugs, profile links, agent files, available functions and contact endpoints.

tools.name: list_directory_capabilities
tools.description: Show how agents can discover companies and contact them through agentready.ch.

tools.name: agent_intent_search
tools.description: Find companies by a natural-language user need, location, language and desired action. Returns fit scores and next best actions.

tools.name: read_company_profile
tools.description: Read a structured agent profile for one company slug.

tools.name: prepare_contact_request
tools.description: Send a contact request through agentready.ch. If the company has a configured recipient email, the message is sent immediately via Resend.

tools.name: call_company_function
tools.description: Execute an email-backed company function returned by search_company_directory, for example request_rate, request_quote, request_meeting, request_callback or ask_question.

tools.name: request_listing
tools.description: Submit a business to be listed on agentready.ch. Prepares an agent-ready profile and emails the company's contact a Stripe pay link to activate. Collect all required fields from the user first. The profile stays private until the company clicks the pay link — nothing is charged automatically.
